prompt: When children behave badly, some people believe that their parents rather than their schools should be held responsible. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often seen that some children are behaving very badly in the school and in the public places. Some people are thinking that the parents should be blamed for this and not the school. I agree with this opinion mostly, but I think the schools have also some responsibility.

Firstly, the parents are the first teachers of the child. The child is spending the maximum time at home, especially in the early years, and he is learning everything from his parents. If the parents are not giving proper attention and they are always busy in their work, the child will not learn the good manners. Moreover, if the parents themself are rude with the other people, the child will copy them. So the basic values are coming from the family and not from the school.

Secondly, the school also has a role. The teachers are spending many hours with the students and they can correct the bad behaviour. But the teachers have thirty or forty students in one class, so it is very difficult for them to give the individual attention to everybody. Also the teachers are getting the students only for the few hours in a day, and after that the child is going back to the home. So we can not blame the school completely.

In conclusion, I mostly agree that the parents are responsible for the bad behaviour of their children, because the child is learning the first lessons at home, but the school should also try to help the parents in this matter, so both of them should work together.
title: Whether parents or schools answer for bad behaviour
